strings.privacy.title: Tūmataitinga
strings.privacy.description: Te whakahaere a pdffusion i ōu kōnae: kāore he pūkete, kāore he tuhinga i puritia, kāore he pānui, kāore hoki he hokonga raraunga.
strings.privacy.intro: I hangaia a pdffusion kia noho tonu ai ōu tuhinga māu. Anei, mā ngā kupu mārama, te mea ka tupu ina whakamahia.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Ō kōnae
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Ka tukuna mai i raro i te whakamunatanga (HTTPS), ka tukatukaina ā-aunoa, kātahi ka mukua ina rite te hua. Ka haere ngā kōnae nunui mā roto i te wāhi pupuri rangirua i raro i te ingoa matapōkere, ka mukua hoki ina oti te tukatuka; mā tētahi horoinga aunoa e tango ngā mea katoa i roto i te 24 hora te roa rawa.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Kāore he pūkete, kāore he raraunga whaiaro
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: Kāore a pdffusion e tono rīhitatanga, wāhitau īmēra, kāri nama rānei. Kāore rawa ō tuhinga e pānuitia, e tātarihia, e tohaina, e whakamahia rānei hei whakangungu i te mātauranga horihori.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Inenga hunga mātakitaki
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Ka tatau mātou i ngā toro ā-ingoamuna me te kore pihikete (Vercel Web Analytics) ki te kimi ko tēhea ngā taputapu e whai hua ana. Kāore he pānui, kāore he whai wāhi whakawhiti paetukutuku.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Pihikete
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: He pihikete kotahi, he kōwhiringa anō: ka maumahara ki te reo i kōwhiria e koe.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Manaaki tūmau
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Kei a Vercel i Paris te paetukutuku; ko ngā hurihanga Word, Excel me PowerPoint ka whakahaeretia e Render i Frankfurt. Mā ēnei kaiwhakarato e whakahaere ngā kōnae i te wā o te hurihanga anake.

strings.legal.terms.title: Ngā tikanga whakamahi
strings.legal.terms.description: He koreutu a pdffusion mā te katoa, tae atu ki ngā pakihi me ngā kāwanatanga. Ka noho tonu āu tuhinga māu anō: kāore tētahi e tātarihia, e puritia rānei.
strings.legal.terms.intro: Ko ēnei tikanga hei whakahaere i tō whakamahi i a pdffusion. He poto noa iho, ā, he mārama hoki te reo. Mā te whakamahi i te pae, ka whakaae koe ki ēnei tikanga.
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].title: Ko wai te kaiwhakaputa o pdffusion
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: Ko pdffusion i hoahoatia, i hangaia, i whakaputaina hoki e Mikailou Cedric Toure, he kaiwhakawhanake nō New Brunswick, Kānata.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: He raihana whakamahi koreutu mā te katoa
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: He koreutu a pdffusion, kāore he rēhitatanga, kāore hoki he here wā, mā te katoa: ngā tāngata takitahi, ngā ākonga, ngā kaiako, ngā pakihi, ngā rōpū kore-hua, ngā tari kāwanatanga me ngā kāwanatanga, ki Kānata me tētahi atu whenua. Kāore tētahi whakamahinga e rāhuitia mō tētahi mahere utu, i te mea kāore tētahi i reira. Ko ngā kōnae ka puta i a koe nōu anō katoa: kāore he tohu wai, kāore hoki he whakahua mō pdffusion.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: Ō tuhinga katoa, tae atu ki ngā mea muna

Ko koe tonu te rangatira, ā, kei a koe tonu te haepapa mō te whai i ngā mana e tika ana hei tukatuka i a rātou.

strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Whakamahi e whakaaetia ana
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: Kāore e whakaaetia kia whakamahia a pdffusion mō ngā mahi hē, te ngana ki te whakararu i te ratonga (te tukuake aunoa nui, te ngana ki te kuhu) te takahi rānei i ōna here hangarau. Ko ngā here mō te rahi me te tau o ngā kōnae hei tiaki i te ratonga mā te katoa.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Wātea
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: Ka whakaratohia a pdffusion mō te kore utu. Tērā pea ka panoni, ka motuhia mō te tiaki, ka whakamutua rānei. Kia mau tonu ki ō tuhinga taketake: kāore a pdffusion e pupuri i tētahi kape.
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].title: Pūtāhui me te taunahatanga
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].text: Ka whakaratohia te ratonga “pēnei tonu i te ahua”, kāore he pūtāhui o tētahi momo. Ki te nui rawa e whakaaetia ana e te ture, kāore te kaiwhakaputa e takohia mō ngā kino kiko, te ngaro o ngā raraunga, te hua rānei kāore i tino tika. Tirohia ngā tuhinga ka whakaputaina e koe i mua i te whakamahi mō tētahi mea nui.

strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: Ko te ingoa pdffusion, tōna waitohu me ngā tuhinga o te pae nō te kaiwhakaputa; ko te waehere kei raro i te raihana MIT pēnei i te kīia i runga ake. Ko ngā tohu hokohoko i whakahua (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…) nō ō rātou ake rangatira.

strings.legal.security.title: Haumarutanga me ngā raraunga
strings.legal.security.description: He aha te mea ka pā ki ō kōnae i runga i a pdffusion: te tukatuka aunoa, kāore he tātari, te mukutanga tonutanga, te whakamuna, te manaaki i Ūropi, me te kōwhiringa ki te tāuta ki runga i ō ake tūmau.
strings.legal.security.intro: He aha te mea ka pā ki ō kōnae, ki hea e tukatukatia ai, me pēhea hoki te tiaki: ka whakamāramatia māmā noa iho, mā te tangata takitahi me ngā tari IT hoki.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Kāore he tuhinga e puritia ana
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Ko ō kōnae ka tukatukatia aunoatia, kā muri ka mukua i te wā tonu e rite ana te hua, i te wā rānei e tangohia ana. Kāore he kape, kāore he tārua pūrua, kāore hoki he hītori. Mā te horoi aunoa ia rā e muru i ngā kōnae taupua e toe ana, i te rā anō e whai mai ana.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Kāore he tātari
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Kāore tētahi e pānui i ō tuhinga. Kāore e whakararangitia, e tātarihia, e tohatohahia, e whakamahia rānei hei whakangungu i te mātauranga horihori. Kāore he pūkete, kāore he pānui pāpāho, kāore hoki he kōtaha kaiwhirgira i a pdffusion.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Whakamuna
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Ko ia hononga he mea whakamuna (HTTPS) ā, ko te pae e akiaki ana i te whakamuna i ia taenga atu (HSTS). Ko te utauta Tiaki ka whakamuna i ō PDF ki te AES-256; ko te kupuhipa i kōwhiria e koe kāore e puritia ana.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Ki hea e tukatukatia ai ō kōnae
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Ngā utauta pae, PDF me te whakaahua: Vercel, pokapū raraunga Paris (Wīwī, Kotahitanga o Ūropi). Ngā hurihanga Word, Excel me PowerPoint: Render, ki Frankfurt (Tiamana, Kotahitanga o Ūropi). Ngā kōnae neke atu i te 4 MB: whare pukapuka rangitahi Vercel Blob, i raro i te ingoa pōraru, i mukua whai muri i te whakamahi.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Ngā parepare hangarau
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Ngā pane haumarutanga (HSTS, te aukati i te pae kia kaua e mau ki roto i ētahi atu whārangi, te tiaki i te rangirua momo kōnae), ngā wāhitau kōnae taupua e kore e taea te matekau, me tētahi ratonga hurihanga e whakaae ana anake ki ngā tono e mau ana i te tūtohu huna. Ko ia panonitanga waehere ka arowhai aunoatia (ngā whakamātautau, ngā arowhai momo) i mua i te whakaputanga.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Tūmataitinga me te ture e hāngai ana
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: Ko pdffusion e whakaputaina ana ki New Brunswick, ā, e whai ana i te Ture Whakamarumaru Mōhiohio Whaiaro me ngā Kōnae Hiko o Kānata (PIPEDA). Kāore e kohia ana he mōhiohio whaiaro mō ōna kaiwhakamahi: kāore he pūkete, kāore hewāhitau īmēra, kāore he pihikete aroturuki. I hangaia i runga i ngā mātāpono kotahi ki te GDPR o Ūropi me te Ture 25 o Quebec: te whakaiti raraunga, te kore whakamahi anō, te muku whai muri i te tukatuka.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Mō ngā whakahaere whai ture kaha
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Mēnā e rāhuitia ana e ō ture te tuku tuhinga ki tētahi ratonga o waho, tāutatia a pdffusion ki runga i ō ake tūmau. He koreutu te pūmanawa katoa, he pūtake tūmatanui, ā, ka mahi ahakoa kāore he hononga Ipurangi: kāore rawa tētahi kōnae e wehe i tō whatunga. Kei te whārangi kaupapa te aratohu tāuta.
strings.legal.security.sections[7].title: Māramatanga
strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: Ko te waehere pūtake katoa he mea whānui: ka taea e ō rōpū haumarutanga te manatoko i ia o ēnei kīanga.

strings.legal.security.sections[8].text: Ki ōu whakaaro kua kite koe i tētahi hapa haumarutanga? Pūrongotia pūmahara mai i te ripa “Haumarutanga” o te whārangi kaupapa:
strings.legal.accessibility.title: Whakaaturanga urunga
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Pānui whakaaturanga urunga o pdffusion: te taumata WCAG 2.2 AA e whāia ana, ngā tikanga kei te tū, ngā herenga e mōhiotia ana me te pēhea te pūrongo i tētahi taupā.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Me āhei te katoa te whakamahi i a pdffusion, tae atu ki ngā tāngata kāore e kite ana, he ngoikore rānei te tirohanga, he turi, he uaua rānei te rongo, he hauā rānei te tinana, te hinengaro rānei.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Paerewa whāinga
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: Ko tā pdffusion he whai ki te paerewa Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, taumata AA, te paerewa ā-ao W3C. Ko tēnei taumata e kapi ana i ngā whakaritenga a te Paerewa mō te Urunga Tukutuku a te Kāwanatanga o Kānata, te paerewa Ūropi EN 301 549 me te Wāhanga 508 i te United States, e tohu ana ki te WCAG 2.0, 2.1 rānei taumata AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Tūnga ōrite
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: He wāhanga noa iho te ōrite o pdffusion ki te WCAG 2.2 taumata AA: kei raro nei ngā herenga e mōhiotia ana. Ko tēnei pānui i takea mai i tētahi aromatawai ā-roto i kawea i te 2 o Whiringa-ā-nuku, 2026, mā te whakamahi i ngā utauta aunoa (axe, Lighthouse) me ngā arowhai ā-ringa (te papapātuhi, te rerekētanga tae, te topa, ngā pānuitanga). Kāore anō kia kawea he tātari motuhake.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Ngā mea kei te tū
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Ka mahi te pae katoa mā te papapātuhi, me tētahi hononga “Hīkoi atu ki te ihirangi” me tētahi rārangi kitea i te taonga e kaha ana. strings.tools.ocr.seoDescription: Pānuitia te kupu o tētahi PDF karapatia, whakaahua rānei (OCR) kia taea ai e koe te rapu, te tārua, te pānui rānei mā te reo nui. 16 reo, kore utu, kāore e tukuake te tuhinga.
strings.tools.ocr.intro: He whakaahua noa tētahi tuhinga karapatia, whakaahuatia rānei: e kore e taea te rapu kupu, te tārua rānei i tētahi rerenga kōrero. Kei tō pūrākau te pānuitanga: kāore tō tuhinga e tukuake. Ko te tauira anō mō te reo i kōwhiria (he iti MB) ka tikiake kotahi anō.
